name: Drones & drone controllers
source: OUIs checked 2026-11-05 against the IEEE MA-L registry bundled with RFWatch (only blocks registered to the drone makers themselves); Bluetooth SIG company 0x08AA = SZ DJI Technology. SSID patterns are the makers' documented default Wi-Fi names and community-reported cheap-drone defaults. Most current DJI drones link over OcuSync/O4, not Wi-Fi: those are only heard through Remote ID, their phone/controller, or goggles. A match means a drone, its controller or the maker's accessory is near — not that it is filming you.

rules.label: Drone trailer / dock / ground station
rules.note: Wi-Fi of drone operations infrastructure: drone trailers, docks / drone-in-a-box, ground-control stations (GCS) and RPAS crews. Usually an open or simple network the crew's tablets join; the drone itself may link over OcuSync/LTE and stay silent.

rules.label: DJI drone / controller
rules.note: IEEE OUIs registered to SZ DJI Technology (Osmo 20:1F:55 and Ronin F8:40:68 camera/gimbal blocks deliberately excluded). Wi-Fi-linked DJI models (Spark, Mavic Air, Mini SE, Tello, Phantom 3 SE/Standard) advertise these SSIDs; newer models are heard via Remote ID or the controller/goggles.

rules.label: Parrot drone / SkyController
rules.note: Parrot SA OUIs. ANAFI USA / ANAFI UKR are sold to police and militaries; older Parrot OUIs also appear in Parrot car kits and Zik headphones, so an OUI-only match is weaker than an SSID match.

rules.label: Autel / Skydio / Yuneec drone
rules.note: Default Wi-Fi names of Autel EVO and Yuneec drones/controllers. Skydio is matched by the law-enforcement pack (police_drone).

rules.label: Drone maker radio (Teal / Zero Zero / PowerVision / Holy Stone / AeroVironment)
rules.note: Teal Drones (B0:30:C8 — Teal 2 / Black Widow, sold to US military and police), Zero Zero Robotics (84:83:19 — HoverAir), PowerVision (54:7D:40), Holy Stone (00:0C:BF), AeroVironment (00:1A:F9 — Puma/Raven; old AeroVironment EV chargers share it). Plus default SSIDs of common consumer drones.

rules.label: Cheap Wi-Fi FPV drone
rules.note: Default access-point names of unbranded toy/FPV drones that stream video to a phone app over Wi-Fi (WIFI-UAV, FPV_xxxx, RC_DRONE …). These only exist while the drone is powered on.
